Subject: Helio Labs — vendor master setup & PO routing

Hi Sofia,

Great to chat earlier — welcome to Redwood. To get Helio Labs fully configured in our vendor master and to ensure POs flow to the right place, can you please provide the following so Finance can complete the payee record?

Required items (can attach to a reply):
- Legal entity name as registered (exact spelling)
- W9 or equivalent tax form (PDF)
- Primary remit address (street, city, state/province, postal, country)
- Preferred invoice email and AP contact (name, phone, email)
- Bank details for ACH/wire (bank name, account name, account number, routing/SWIFT)
- Authorized signer for contract and who will receive POs (name, title, email)

Optional/helps speed: beneficial owner declaration or UBO form if available.

Two operational notes:
1) Our PO numbers will begin with RDW- and include the project code (e.g., RDW-ENG-12345). Please confirm who on your side should receive POs and which email they want for invoicing.
2) We use the vendor portal for invoice submission; we can invite your AP contact once the payee record is created.

Jordan, Kimberly — FYI for PO routing and tax verification. If finance needs anything else I can fast-track.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
